title: Property valuation · HousySpace
description: Request a professional valuation of your property in Barcelona.

head.heading: The next property could be yours

items.text: Discover the real value of your property with a professional real estate analysis, based on the market and your property's characteristics.
Enter your property details in the valuation tool and you will instantly receive your valuation report. If you wish, an adviser can review it with you afterwards.

Can't see the valuation tool? [Open it in a new tab](https://valuation.lystos.com?clientId=0cf1b7eb-0479-481f-9d1d-61a1697d5b31) or request a valuation from an adviser using the [form below](#solicitud).

The valuation tool estimate is indicative; it is not an official appraisal. The tool is provided by an external supplier, Lystos: data you enter will be processed according to their privacy information and that of HousySpace (legal text pending approval).
Would you prefer an adviser to call you?
Leave your details and a HousySpace adviser will get in touch to value your property in person.

fields.text: Controller: HousySpace Consultores Inmobiliarios, S.L. Purpose: handling your request and, only if you tick the boxes, sending commercial communications and the newsletter. Legal basis: your consent. Recipients: we do not share your data, except where legally required. Rights: access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction, portability and withdrawal of consent at [info@housyspace.com](mailto:info@housyspace.com); you may lodge a complaint with the AEPD. More information in the [privacy policy](route:privacy). (Legal text draft.)
No system is yet in place to receive the form (CRM pending). Clicking will open WhatsApp with your request pre-filled for you to send; until you send it there, it will not have reached HousySpace.
